verifiedHistoricalNotes: AppDatabase.schemaVersion is 9 (Projects Stage 1 foundation baseline) and released onUpgrade branches execute sequentially in ascending order for from < 2 through from < 9.

AppDatabase.migration.onUpgrade enforces an explicit fail-closed if (from > to) guard throwing UnsupportedDatabaseVersionException before any from < N branch or createPerformanceIndices() runs (Drift MigrationStrategy has no onDowngrade callback).
SQLite runtime execution of Flutter migration tests requires Flutter SDK / Dart / SQLite native bindings in CI (not available locally in this container).
